text:
Interesting: `git diff HEAD --stat` only shows 3 files, not logger.h, command_validate.cc, test file. That means those changes are committed in HEAD (b81ff74 etc.), and HEAD moved. `git diff HEAD` compares working tree to HEAD, and since logger.h/command_validate/test were committed as wip commits, they don't show. Fine. The tree contains all changes.

Wait but command_validate.cc shows in git log as committed b81ff74 but `git diff HEAD -- src/command_validate.cc` produced nothing, confirming it's in HEAD. Good.

So final tree has all 5 sites converted + helper + test update. Let me verify by grepping the whole src tree for ad-hoc "warning:".
